title: Company benefit
hint: If your employer offers a Kiorex benefit, join with the code you were given.
codeHelp: Letters and numbers only. Dashes and spaces are ignored.
orEmail: No code? If your company e-mail address is verified in your Kiorex account, you can join without one.
how: The benefit reduces the deposit of a booking when you pay it, up to your allowance. It has no cash value and cannot be transferred, gifted or withdrawn.
privacy: Your employer never sees who joined, who you book or why. They receive anonymous totals only, and only for groups of 10 people or more.
leaveHint: You stop being eligible at once. Bookings that already used the benefit are not changed.
terms: Programme terms and your data rights are shown here once counsel has approved the wording.
